name: Eo Gio
kicker: The rock saddle above the sea
summary: Rock saddle on Phuong Mai: stand in the gap for about 30 minutes and look down at the sea. The ticket is 25,000 đồng, and a child under 0.9 m is free. The calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay off the rocks when the sea is rough, and come for the sunset through the gap.
getThere: On Phuong Mai, east of the lagoon.
bestMonths: Lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9, when the sea is calm
heroCaption: The saddle at Eo Gió, with both rock walls and the sea

figures.caption: The saddle at Eo Gió, with both rock walls and the sea
figures.alt: The rock saddle at Eo Gio above the sea

notice.title: Stay away in a rough sea
notice.body: The calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. When the sea is rough, leave the saddle.

gettingThere: The saddle is on Phuong Mai, east of the lagoon. One address line reads khu số 4, Nhơn Lý–Cát Tiến, Phường Quy Nhơn Đông. The other reads khu vực 3, thôn Lý Lương, xã đảo Nhơn Lý.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: Across Thị Nại, then along Phuong Mai to the saddle.

closed: No weekly closing day is listed. Stay away when the sea is rough.
admissionNote: 25,000 đồng. A child under 0.9 m is free.
